newsitem.title: USA: Merisel to sell units to CHS.
newsitem.headline: Merisel to sell units to CHS.

text.p: CHS Electronics Inc has agreed to buy substantially all of Merisel Inc's European operations as well as its Latin American and Mexican businesses, for about $160 million, Merisel said on Friday.
The sale price is subject to adjustments based on the closing balance sheets of the firms being purchased, it said.
Sale proceeds will include $130 million cash plus CHS's assumption of Merisel's European asset securitization facility.
The agreement is subject to several conditions, including CHS's ability to complete financing and the consent of Merisel's banks and holders of privately issued debt.
The transaction is expected to close at the end of September or as soon thereafter as possible.
CHS is buying businesses that employ about 1,000 people and are expected to generate revenue of about $1.5 billion in 1996.
Claudio Osorio, CHS chief executive officer, said the deal doubles its size and strengthens its position in Western Europe and Latin America.
With the acquisitions, CHS sales in South America will approach $1.0 billion in 1997 and it gains a presence in Mexico, "an important market where we have not yet been active," he said.
